data.name: Marrowtide
data.detailed_description:
A New Experience in the Card Battler Genre

Experience a card battler from a new perspective in the form of Marrowtide. By combining the classic movement and grid style of tactics games and the beloved deckbuilding and a card mechanics of card battlers, explore the new possibilities in strategy and combat.

Turn-Based Card Combat

Marrowtide is heavily inspired by iconic card games like Slay the Spire. The card combat offers many possibilities for deck composition, card synergies and general strategies.

Tactics style Movement

Marrowtide's tactics style movement offers another layer to the strategy. Positioning and managing movement plays a big part is battling your way through the levels.

data.short_description: Marrowtide is a strategy-focused experience intended to unify the core mechanics of the legendary strategy mechanics from Slay the Spire’s deckbuilding on XCOM’s 3D battlefield and action system.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD RX 580 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Designed for 1080p @ 30-60 FPS on Low/Medium settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p - 1440p @ 60+ FPS on High settings.
